result.summary: The page appears mostly functional with one notable visual issue identified.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel is truncated mid-word without an ellipsis, making it appear broken rather than intentionally clipped. The text cuts off abruptly at 'Piccol' instead of showing 'Trattoria Piccolo...' with proper ellipsis truncation.
issues.suggestion: Apply CSS text-overflow: ellipsis with overflow: hidden and white-space: nowrap to the restaurant name text element so truncation is visually clean and intentional-looking.
